messages.author: 2da1c23e40659cff
messages.subject: inla mode
parts:
Dear all, 

I have a question regarding the mode of INLA. In order to have the posterior marginal distribution of the hyper-parameters estimated using numerical integration I am attempting to use the  inla.hyperpar() function, but I continously get the warning: " inla.hyperpar: Only for inla.mode='classic', skip... "

I understand that there are 2 modes, classic and experimental, but I can't seem to find any information on the differences between these, or how to set a particular mode.

Thank you for your time and consideration,
Ismael Ahmad

messages.author: 3eab71733027a24a
messages.subject: Re: [r-inla] inla mode
parts:
sorry for late reply.

the `new'-INLA ('experimental' or 'compact') is described in

https://www.sciencedirect.com/science/article/abs/pii/S0167947323000038

and is the way we're going forward now. there is an arxiv version is you do not
have access.

default is inla(...,inla.mode="compact") and new features might now only appear
in this mode.
